summary: A large Dubai brokerage office page appears to lose enquiries to non dialling links, one WhatsApp number for all brokers and thin proof.

findings.problem: The office phone link appears to lack a country code while the footer number has one, and the chat widget appears to use a US format number.
findings.cost: Callers from abroad may fail to connect, and the chat number looks wrong for Dubai.
findings.fix: Proper call links and one verified chat number.

findings.problem: Every broker WhatsApp button appears to point to the same number.
findings.cost: Clients cannot reach the specific broker they chose.
findings.fix: Each broker linked to their own number.

findings.problem: The Dubai Hills and Dubai South addresses appear truncated, two offices appear to share one address, and the count of 34 brokers appears to be 35.
findings.cost: Address and count errors make the office look careless.

findings.problem: No client reviews or transaction figures appear for this office, and Talk to this office appears to lead to the general contact page.
findings.cost: Owners and buyers want proof and a direct next step.
findings.fix: Office reviews, results and a direct office form.
